explication: IPTV-API collects local and subscription-based channel sources, normalizes and aggregates candidates, tests stream availability and quality, then generates playlists and API-accessible results. Its desktop and legacy Tk interfaces expose configuration and operational controls; the desktop controller dispatches channel operations and manages service interactions. The README also documents EPG, RTMP streaming, playback screenshots, and result management. The excerpts show selected orchestration and storage behavior, so links for unsampled feature wiring are omitted where uncertain.
